description: This file defines a report for recruitment analytics in an ERP system, including functions to fetch and organize data related to staffing plans, job openings, applicants, and offers.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure of the report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and organizes the report data based on filters.

methods.name: get_parent_row
methods.description: Generates parent rows for each staffing plan and associated job openings.

methods.name: get_child_row
methods.description: Generates child rows for each job applicant and related job offers.

methods.name: get_staffing_plan
methods.description: Retrieves staffing plan details from the database.

methods.name: get_job_opening
methods.description: Retrieves job openings associated with staffing plans.

methods.name: get_job_applicant
methods.description: Retrieves job applicants for given job openings.

methods.name: get_job_offer
methods.description: Retrieves job offers for given applicants.
